project.name: Denhead of Arbirlot
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary audit. Denhead of Arbirlot remains selector-only at 20 because it is a farm locality, not an independently worthwhile settlement. The official 27.5 km Circuit through Rural Angus is published separately as a trail that passes through, without inflating the settlement score. Local HES reconciliation found no statutory designations and retained all three NRHE records. The Carmyllie Light Railway record has an official 19th-century classification and is visible; the cist and possible promontory fort remain period-unassigned and map-hidden. No qualifying café-led eat stop, managed picnic place, dedicated public visitor parking or public toilet was verified. No exact Denhead product was found at Treasure Trails, Curious About, Mystery Guides or GoQuest. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
